subject.title: Feature Request: Stream Repetition Safeguard (Halt & Confirm)

question: What product contract should OpenClaw use when a model repeatedly streams identical or cyclic assistant text: abort-only, pause-and-confirm, retry/failover, session rollback, or some combination?
rationale: The source boundary is clear, but default strictness, false-positive tolerance, whether `/approve` should resume a suspect generation, and how to sanitize session history are product and compatibility decisions automation should not invent.

options.title: Approve Core Stream Guard
options.body: Define default thresholds, alert wording, abort/retry/resume behavior, and session cleanup, then implement the guard with regression and live-channel proof.

options.title: Defer To Timeout Work
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for generation-timeout and provider-watchdog decisions before adding semantic stream detection.

options.title: Reject Resume Semantics
options.body: Allow only abort-and-quarantine behavior for detected repetition, avoiding a manual resume path that may continue poisoned output.

recommendation.title: Approve Core Stream Guard
recommendation.body: Define default thresholds, alert wording, abort/retry/resume behavior, and session cleanup, then implement the guard with regression and live-channel proof.
